cross_branch_dependencies.relevance: FRANK target effects must remain mediated by live runtime authority; Harness/compiler acceptance needs evidence that exact runtime semantics were executed.
Harness is the primary executable discriminator and must consume verified execution receipts rather than workflow definitions or optimistic labels.
Gate state should be stored as append-only evidence-backed transitions, preserving DEFINED/QUEUED/RUNNING/EXECUTED/VERIFIED/ADMITTED distinctions and source/material identities.
Receipt/provenance links may be graph-projected for retrieval, but graph activation or connectivity must never promote gate truth.
Workspace selection may surface gate evidence but cannot convert relevance/broadcast into release truth or effect authority.
Intervention/replay measurements need exact executable artifact and harness identities so a changed build is not misread as a causal system effect.
Before verification, multiple possible execution/admission states may remain explicit; uncertainty must not collapse into PASS.
Whole-system semantic fabric should preserve orthogonality of truth, provenance, authority and execution evidence.
Direct current BASE blocker: runtime ABI/FFI and compiler gates require proof-carrying, exact-digest execution receipts without adding new core syntax.

contradiction_scan.description: Current commit wording says execute/gate while inspected repository evidence shows workflow definitions without the declared receipt files. Treating commit title or workflow presence as execution would conflict with the project's work-plan != execution and receipt-gated acceptance laws.

Freeze/front-end/typed-IR artifacts reference different grammar generations. Exact material digests are therefore required in execution receipts; no semantic mismatch is claimed without a differential counterexample.
Build/test attestation is provenance/evidence, while CapabilityHandle is live execution authority. Existing ClayCode laws already require this separation.
Hosted Ubuntu CI is useful regression evidence but current project state explicitly requires Andreas Ubuntu developer-host acceptance; receipt scope must preserve that distinction.
